## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the narrow reason for this change.

## Evidence

Link the official source, issue or contract. For UI changes, attach desktop,
mobile and Arabic/RTL evidence when applicable.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were written or updated before the implementation.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] MCP and REST v1 compatibility is preserved or the migration is documented.
- [ ] New upstream reads are bounded and use the shared SSRF-safe HTTP path.
- [ ] Results retain citation, licence, quality and lineage metadata.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, production logs or captured private records are committed.
- [ ] Arabic and English copy remain accurate where the public interface is bilingual.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behaviour changes.

## Limitations

State what this change does not prove or support. Do not leave this section blank
for a new data source, connector, indicator or evidence product.
